title: Chapter 2722: Fighting the Invader(2)

Chapter 2722: Fighting the Invader(2)

After absorbing her flames, the invader continued rushing toward Ironwoman.

"How dare you ignore us?!" General Gu shouted as he waved his sleeves, striking the invader from the side with a powerful martial technique and knocking it down again.

The invader turned its faceless head toward General Gu, sending chills through his entire being. However, it swiftly lost interest and continued going after Ironwoman.

Seeing this, Supreme General Tian shouted, warning everyone there, "It’s trying to capture her! Stop it!"

He immediately activated a martial technique, and thousands of arcs of electricity coiled and snaked around his body.

Then his body flickered and vanished into thin air, replaced by a lightning streak that shot toward the invader and collided with it.

Boom!

A massive sparkling explosion erupted on impact, sending the invader flying once again. This time, however, it couldn’t simply shrug off the attack, and its movements were seemingly restricted.

The invader’s aura surged the next moment, and a chilling, otherworldly shriek echoed throughout the city.

"Is that sound coming from the monster?! How is it even making that noise without a mouth?!" someone exclaimed.

Once the shriek came to an end, the invader moved again, shooting toward Supreme General Tian at blinding speed.

Supreme General Tian tried to evade, but his reaction was just a fraction too slow, and he failed to avoid the attack completely.

"Fuck!" Supreme General Tian cursed out loud as the attack tore through his left arm, his voice in agony.

"Supreme General!" Mei Feng cried out as she attacked the invader, hoping to draw its attention.

However, her attacks had no effect on the invader, so it completely ignored her and continued targeting Supreme General Tian.

Supreme General Tian struggled to keep up, but alas, the invader’s speed and prowess were simply too overwhelming. Before long, he lost his right leg as well.

The other two generals continued attacking the invader relentlessly, but none of their attacks seemed to have any effect.

Seeing this, Ironwoman gritted her teeth and shouted, "You want me, right?! Then you’ll have to catch me first!"

The next moment, she turned around and fled, flying away from the city at full speed.

Sensing her presence rapidly moving away, the invader immediately lost interest in Supreme General Tian and chased after her instead.

"Stop it! Don’t let it capture her!" Supreme General Tian shouted.

"Even if we go after them, there’s literally nothing we can do against that thing!" General Gu shook his head, believing it would be pointless to pursue them.

"We should honor her sacrifice and focus on reorganizing the military."

Mei Feng gritted her teeth and clenched her fists in silence. As much as she hated to admit it, she agreed with General Gu.

It was painfully clear that no one there possessed the strength to stop the invader, and recklessly chasing after it would be no different from throwing their lives away.

"Damn it... Where the hell is that bastard when we need him the most?!" Supreme General Tian growled in a low voice when he realized that they had no choice but to let the invader chase after Ironwoman.

"He went to deal with the Void Hunter," a familiar voice suddenly resounded.

Supreme General Tian turned toward the voice, his eyes widening in disbelief when he saw Yu Rou.

Although a veil concealed her face, he recognized her identity at a glance.

"Y-You! What are you doing out here?! You need to go back! It’s too dangerous for you to be outside right now!" he shouted at her.

"Too dangerous?" Yu Rou muttered, then replied calmly, "There is no longer a place in this world that is safe."

"Gaia..." Mei Feng called out to her. "What do you mean Yuan went to deal with the Void Hunter?"

"Exactly what it sounds like. I asked him to eliminate the Void Hunter because we need it gone if we want to cooperate with the other cities. It would be unrealistic to defend against the invaders from within a single city, and fighting outside isn’t an option as long as the Void Hunter continues hunting us."

"Wait... that unfathomable aura we felt right before the invaders appeared... don’t tell me that was actually the Void Hunter?!" Supreme General Tian exclaimed upon realizing this.

Until now, he had assumed the aura belonged to the invaders.

Yu Rou approached Supreme General Tian and held her palms before him, pouring her energy into his body and rapidly healing his injuries.

A few seconds later, once he was fully healed, Supreme General Tian said to the others, "I’m going after Ironwoman."

"But—!"

General Gu tried to object, but Supreme General Tian quickly shut him down.

"Your attacks may not work, but that invader was vulnerable to mine. I’d rather sacrifice my own life than hers. She’s still young, and her talent surpasses even mine. I refuse to let someone with that much potential die today—at least not before me."

Without hesitation, Supreme General Tian left the scene, soaring in the direction Ironwoman and the invader had gone.

"Why didn’t you stop him?" General Gu turned to Yu Rou and asked.

"I have no right to dictate how he decides to retire..." she responded.

"That invader seemed obsessed with Ironwoman. Do you know why?" Mei Feng then asked.

"It wants to take her to whatever is beyond our sky... As for the purpose, I don’t have the slightest clue," Yu Rou replied with a low sigh.

Meanwhile, the invader had finally caught up to Ironwoman right as they reached the Red Zone.

Realizing the invader had caught up, Ironwoman stopped running and turned to face it.

"I could’ve never imagined that this would be how I die when I left my family and background behind to go to another city..." Ironwoman sighed as she removed her mask.

"But it’s still better than becoming a political tool for my family..."

Without a word, the invader lunged at her. However, instead of trying to kill her, it moved with the clear intention of capturing her.
